# Temple Scroll Column 7 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 7 | **Condition:** Heavily damaged to fragmentary; Festival of New Oil

---

**7:1** [...and-you-shall-count] from-that day seven weeks [...]

**7:2** [...] seven times [...] forty-nine days [...]

**7:3** [...] you-shall-count [...] until the-morrow of-the-seventh sabbath [...]

**7:4** [...] fifty days [...] and-you-shall-bring new oil [...]

**7:5** [...] first-fruits of-oil [...] upon the-altar [...]

**7:6** [...] from-the-sons-of-Israel [...] from-each of-the-tribes [...]

**7:7** [...] half a hin of-oil [...] new pressed-oil [...]

**7:8** [...] and-they-shall-bring [...] the first of-the-new-oil to-the-LORD [...]

**7:9** [...] and-the-priests shall-offer first [...] and-shall-anoint with-it [...]

**7:10** [...] the-burnt-offering [...] and-the-grain-offering [...]

**7:11** [...] and-after-them the-Levites [...] and-then the-sons-of-Israel [...]

---

*EMET notes: Column 7 legislates the Festival of New Oil (chag ha-yitshar), another unique Temple Scroll festival falling fifty days after the Festival of New Wine (hence 150 days after Passover). The oil is offered as first fruits. The half-hin measure for each tribal contribution and the anointing of the burnt offering with the new oil are distinctive features. The same hierarchical order (priests, Levites, Israel) is maintained.*
